verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a locally run, open-source multimedia CLI and library set. It is not a hosted service that collects or retains user data, so an opt-out from AI-model training is not a fair axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence suggests FFmpeg gathers user data that could be used for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
